_comment: Chapter 7 of the story revamp (docs/gameplay/23 §4): F32, Liora at the Star's door: the plan (c7.plan, trust + 1) if her mirror was made whole (c6.mirror).

text.zh_TW: 星之門上刻著一隻手的形狀。你把手放上去，門的另一邊傳來莉歐拉的聲音。
text.en: The Star's door bears the carved shape of a hand. You lay your hand on it, and Liora's voice comes from the other side.

text.zh_TW: 莉歐拉：「聽好。星星裂了，神就從裂縫進來。要重新點亮它，得有一個神裔把那個神的力量倒回星星裡——不是拿走，是還回去。我開門，你倒力量。我們一起。」
text.en: Liora: "Listen. The Star is cracked, and the god comes in through the crack. To light it again, a Godborn has to pour the god's power back into the Star. Not take it. Give it back. I open the door, you pour the power. Together."

text.zh_TW: 門後的聲音斷斷續續：「……不要……讓它……進去……」然後就沒有聲音了。
text.en: The voice behind the door comes in fragments: "...don't... let it... in..." Then there is nothing.
